conventions.commits: Conventional Commits format with GPG signing and DCO sign-off (-S --signoff)
conventions.testing: Unit tests in #[cfg(test)] modules, integration tests in crates/aptu-coder/tests/, use make_test_analyzer() helper
conventions.linting: cargo fmt --check, cargo clippy -- -D warnings, cargo deny check advisories licenses
conventions.error_handling: No .unwrap() in production code, use .expect("reason") instead; every unsafe block requires SAFETY comment

patterns: Language registration pattern: add mod declaration in mod.rs, add to get_language_info() and get_ts_language() match arms
Query constants pattern: ELEMENT_QUERY, CALL_QUERY, REFERENCE_QUERY, IMPORT_QUERY, DEFUSE_QUERY as pub const &str
Extension mapping pattern: add ("ext", "lang") entry to EXTENSION_MAP in lang.rs
Inheritance extraction: extract_inheritance handler walks child_by_field_name("superclass") and child_by_field_name("interfaces")

related_issues.title: Add Swift grammar support via tree-sitter-swift 0.7.3

constraints: All languages unconditionally compiled in; no feature gates
New language files must include SPDX header at line 1
DEFUSE_QUERY required for languages with local variable tracking
test_coverage: Language registration has unit tests in mod.rs test module: test_get_language_info_known, test_get_language_info_unknown, test_get_ts_language_known, test_get_ts_language_unknown. Java has extensive integration tests including test_extract_function_name, test_find_receiver_type, test_find_method_for_receiver, test_java_element_query_happy_path, test_java_extract_inheritance, test_defuse_query_write_site.

library_findings.notes: Alex Pinkus maintained, MIT license, 0.23.x tree-sitter peer dependency
Workspace dependency, used by all language handlers

approaches.name: Full Swift Handler (Modeled after Java)
approaches.description: Create swift.rs with full query constants and handlers, add to mod.rs, add to EXTENSION_MAP, add dependencies

approaches.name: Minimal Swift Handler (CSS-like)
approaches.description: Create swift.rs with only ELEMENT_QUERY and CALL_QUERY, no handlers, no DEFUSE_QUERY

approaches.name: Swift Handler with DEFUSE_QUERY (Recommended)
approaches.description: Create swift.rs with ELEMENT_QUERY, CALL_QUERY, DEFUSE_QUERY, and extract_inheritance handler; skip other optional handlers
pros: DEFUSE_QUERY required for proper symbol tracking
cons: Requires Swift grammar node type knowledge

recommendation: Approach 3 (Swift Handler with DEFUSE_QUERY) provides the best balance. DEFUSE_QUERY is required because aptu-coder's symbol tracking and call graph features depend on it for identifying variable definitions and uses. Without it, Swift files would have incomplete semantic analysis. The extract_inheritance handler is valuable for Swift's class/protocol inheritance model.

    pub find_method_for_receiver: Option<FindMethodForReceiverHandler>,
    pub find_receiver_type: Option<FindReceiverTypeHandler>,

inheritance_walk_citation: Based on tree-sitter-swift grammar structure: for class_declaration, walk child_by_field_name("superclass") to get the parent type, then child_by_field_name("protocols") for protocol list. Each protocol entry has type_identifier nodes. The inheritance_specifier field contains inherits_from which leads to user_type/type_identifier nodes.
